name: pi-native-experience
description: Improve the Pi provider: two parallel lanes (memory footprint, native integration parity) plus a dependent lead integration/verification task.

tasks.title: Reduce Pi provider memory footprint
tasks.detail: Audit and reduce the memory footprint of the Pi provider integration. Scope: lib/piClient.ts, lib/piMapper.ts, and any Pi-specific caches/pools they own. Context: the Pi SDK (@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent) is already lazy-loaded (saved ~86MB); there is single-flight AgentSession pooling with prewarm (cold open was ~19s); commit 70f5808 'Reduce Pi TUI memory retention' just landed — read it first (git show 70f5808) and continue that work, do not undo it. Steps: 1) Run npm install in your worktree. 2) Profile where Pi retains memory: pool entries, session caches, mapper accumulation, listener leaks on dispose; write a small Node script if useful. 3) Implement bounded/LRU retention for anything unbounded, ensure dispose() paths actually release AgentSessions and listeners, and avoid retaining full message arrays where the mapper only needs deltas. 4) Verify with npx tsc --noEmit (the completion gate runs it too) and publish before/after evidence (heap numbers or retained-object reasoning) via coord_publish_finding. Keep changes surgical. Do NOT touch lib/provider.ts or lib/sessionBackend.ts — the pi-native lane owns those; coord_send_message that lane if you find integration-level issues they should fix.

tasks.title: Make Pi a native-feeling provider (capability + UX parity)
tasks.detail: Close the gap between Pi and the best-integrated providers (Claude/Codex) so Pi feels native in AgentViewer. Steps: 1) Run npm install in your worktree. 2) Audit PI_CAPABILITIES in lib/provider.ts against what the Pi SDK actually supports (read node_modules/@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent typings): fork/rewind/delete/summarize/share/models/steering — find capabilities that are wrongly disabled or unimplemented backend ops in lib/sessionBackend.ts pi branches (grep "provider === 'pi'"). 3) Implement the highest-value gaps so web + TUI controls light up for Pi, prioritizing (a) session-action parity in lib/sessionBackend.ts, (b) composer affordances (model list, slash commands) matching what the pi CLI offers, (c) live status/reasoning polish (a pi_status channel already exists). 4) Do NOT edit lib/piClient.ts or lib/piMapper.ts — the pi-memory lane owns those; if you need a client-level change, coord_send_message the pi-memory lane and agree on who lands it. 5) Verify with npx tsc --noEmit (the completion gate runs it too) and publish every capability you enabled plus how to see it in the UI via coord_publish_finding. Note: Pi model access on this machine works via openai-codex/gpt-5.4 (ChatGPT OAuth); the anthropic key has no credits — relevant if you live-test.

tasks.title: Lead: review, merge lanes, verify Pi end-to-end
tasks.detail: Lead integration task (blocked until both lanes complete): review both lane diffs (their worktrees live under .agent-viewer-data/coord-worktrees/<runId>/), reconcile any cross-file assumptions, merge both lane branches into the main checkout, run npx tsc --noEmit and npm run tui:check on the merged result, and publish a synthesis of memory savings + native-experience improvements as a finding before completing. If review finds gaps, coord_create_task follow-ups instead of merging broken work.
